title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office’s decision outlines new policies for how AI systems should be managed and deployed. It establishes guidelines for transparency, accountability, and ethical oversight in AI use.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This policy outlines how to fill open positions for technology specialists in AI, detailing the qualifications, responsibilities, and recruitment process. It also sets expectations for how these specialists will work with the AI team to support research, development, and governance of AI systems.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The document announces a job opening for the Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. It outlines the responsibilities, qualifications, and application process for the position.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The policy explains how the organization will recruit and appoint legal officers to fill vacancies in the AI office, outlining eligibility criteria, job responsibilities, and the hiring process. It also sets out the legal and ethical standards these officers must follow to ensure compliance with privacy, data protection, and AI governance regulations.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy outlines plans to create a new AI office and explains the duties, qualifications, and responsibilities of the policy officers who will guide its work. It also describes how these officers will be selected, managed, and held accountable to promote ethical AI use and compliance with regulations.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a specialized group tasked with providing expert scientific guidance on the development and implementation of the European AI Act. They assess technical and societal impacts, offer evidence‑based recommendations, and help shape policy to ensure the regulation is grounded in rigorous, up‑to‑date research.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The document presents an initial request for establishing standardised procedures or guidelines in the AI field. It aims to promote consistent practices that enhance reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation on a forthcoming Community of Practice policy. It invites stakeholders to review, comment on, and help shape the policy’s development.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document announces a call for expressions of interest in forming a Community of Practice (CoP) focused on AI. It invites potential participants to submit their interest and outlines the purpose and next steps for establishing the CoP.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document provides a visual overview of the iterative drafting process used by the Community of Practice. It outlines each stage, from initial conception through successive revisions to the final policy.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document shows a graphic timeline that breaks down each step of drafting the CoP policy. It highlights major milestones, key decision points, and deadlines, giving a clear overview of how the policy was developed.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document presents the first draft of a Code of Practice aimed at guiding organizations in the responsible development and deployment of AI systems. It outlines key principles, best practices, and compliance requirements to ensure ethical, transparent, and accountable use of AI technology.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: A Code of Practice: 2nd Draft provides a set of guidelines and standards for responsible AI development and deployment. It covers principles such as transparency, fairness, and accountability, offering best practices and compliance requirements for organizations using AI systems.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents the third draft of a Code of Practice, detailing guidelines for responsible AI development and deployment. It emphasizes key principles such as transparency, fairness, safety, and accountability to help organizations implement ethical and compliant AI solutions.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a set of principles and commitments for responsible AI development and use. It seeks to promote transparency, safety, and collaboration among stakeholders to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final establishes a set of agreements among participating entities to promote responsible and ethical use of artificial intelligence. It outlines shared standards for transparency, accountability, and safety to build trust and ensure AI technologies benefit society.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: These guidelines explain which AI practices are forbidden, such as those that could cause harm, spread disinformation, or violate privacy. They outline the rules and examples so that developers and users know what to avoid in order to stay compliant with the policy.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: These guidelines explain what types of software and technologies are considered AI systems, helping organizations identify and classify them. They also outline the key rules and responsibilities that must be followed to ensure proper use and oversight of such systems.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This document outlines strategies for encouraging open communication and collaboration to support the growth of start‑ups and foster innovation. It highlights measures such as sharing resources, building partnerships, and creating supportive policies to help new businesses thrive and accelerate technological advancement.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups aims to give early‑stage companies across Europe access to high‑performance computing resources, funding, and technical expertise so they can innovate and grow. It provides start‑ups with state‑of‑the‑art HPC infrastructure, mentorship, and networking opportunities to accelerate product development and commercial success.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar presents a slideshow overview of risk management strategies, covering key principles, tools, and best practices for identifying and mitigating risks in organizations. The session aims to equip participants with actionable insights to assess risk exposure and implement effective controls.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar covers the fundamentals of risk management in the context of AI, explaining how to identify potential threats, assess their impact, and develop mitigation strategies. It also highlights tools and best practices for continuous monitoring and compliance to ensure responsible AI deployment.
